<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two overlapping peaks), and 127.40 (two overlapping peaks). Counting these gives 6 aromatic carbon signals. The remaining peak at 168.20 ppm corresponds to a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
